rationales: Oscar Hertwig discovered meiosis in 1876.
1786 is not the year of Hertwig’s discovery.
1867 is not the year of Hertwig’s discovery.
1768 is not the year of Hertwig’s discovery.
Prophase I is the longest phase of meiosis because it includes several substages and pairing of homologous chromosomes.
Metaphase I is shorter than Prophase I.
Anaphase I is shorter than Prophase I.
Telophase I is shorter than Prophase I.
Ibn-e-Nafees did not propose the induced-fit model.
Emil Fischer proposed the lock-and-key model, not the induced-fit model.
Louis Pasteur did not propose the induced-fit model.
Daniel Koshland proposed the induced-fit model of enzyme action.
The stroma is where the Calvin cycle occurs, not the light reactions.
The cytoplasm is not the site of photosynthetic light reactions.
Light reactions take place on the thylakoid membranes of chloroplasts.
Mitochondria are not the site of photosynthetic light reactions.
Defecation is the elimination of undigested food from the body.
Absorption is the passage of digested nutrients into the blood or lymph.
Assimilation is the use of absorbed nutrients by body cells.
Ingestion is the taking of food into the body.
Two months is shorter than the typical RBC lifespan.
Three months is shorter than the typical RBC lifespan.
An RBC lives for about 120 days, or four months.
Five months is longer than the typical RBC lifespan.
3.9% is greater than the typical salt concentration of plasma.
Blood plasma contains about 0.9% salts by weight.
1.9% is greater than the typical salt concentration of plasma.
2.9% is greater than the typical salt concentration of plasma.
A habitat is the place where an organism lives, not a group of the same species.
The biosphere includes all regions of Earth where life exists.
A community consists of populations of different species living together.
A population is members of the same species living in the same place at the same time.
Deductions are the logical consequences drawn from a hypothesis.
Observations are recorded information, not the logical consequences of a hypothesis.
Experiments test a hypothesis or its deductions.
Summarization is a concise account, not the logical consequences of a hypothesis.
Aristotle did not introduce the modern system of binomial nomenclature.
Carolus Linnaeus introduced the system of binomial nomenclature.
Ernst Haeckel did not introduce the system of binomial nomenclature.
Robert Whittaker proposed a five-kingdom classification, not binomial nomenclature.
Stroma is the fluid-filled space inside chloroplasts.
The matrix is the inner compartment of a mitochondrion.
Cristae are folds or extensions of the inner mitochondrial membrane.
Thylakoids are membrane sacs found in chloroplasts.
DNA and chromosomes are duplicated during the S phase.
G1 is a growth phase before DNA replication.
G0 is a resting or non-dividing state, not the chromosome-duplication phase.
M phase is when cell division occurs, after chromosome duplication.
Chiasmata become visible during Prophase I, when crossing over occurs.
Metaphase I follows the formation of chiasmata.
Anaphase I separates homologous chromosomes.
Telophase I occurs after homologous chromosomes separate.
Carbohydrates are not the main molecular category of enzymes.
Most enzymes are proteins.
Lipids are not the main molecular category of enzymes.
Although some RNA molecules act as enzymes, most enzymes are proteins.
4300 Calories is below the usual energy released by ATP hydrolysis.
5300 Calories is below the usual energy released by ATP hydrolysis.
6300 Calories is below the usual energy released by ATP hydrolysis.
ATP hydrolysis releases about 7.3 kilocalories, or 7300 calories, per mole.
